publishedSpecs.massConvention: OEM brochure explicitly labels base curb weight, not dry mass or GVWR. Fuel fill fraction and driver accounting not specified in read table.

uncertainties: OEM owner manual height is 1680mm/66.1in; press kit and sales brochure both say65.0in. Use press/brochure1651mm provisionally and retain discrepancy, not an exact consensus.
Manual metric wheelbase2530, width1695, tracks1475/1480 differ slightly from direct inch conversions because of rounding.
6400 is published maximum engine speed, not verified fuel-cut calibration.
Idle numeric rpm, CG height, sprung/unsprung split, springs/dampers, torque curve away from peak, clutch and shift timing, frontal area and performance claims not verified.
Do not add a complete fuel tank or driver mass to curb weight blindly; follow runtime mass convention and disclose approximation.
ABLS is brake-based assistance, not a verified mechanical limited-slip differential.
Owner manual covers optional trims; base tires are selected using S-specific brochure/press table.
artDirection: Original 2994 logo-free compact tall five-door wagon, faded plum paint, pale mint repair door, short nose, upright cabin. Distinct split rear window with centered pillar and paired vertical rear lamps; round front lamps and narrow low grille avoid copying Cube face and trademark wraparound treatment. LHD broad shallow dash with left floating blank binnacle; reused shared wheel, no baked gauges.
